faqs.question: Is this licensed therapy or professional counseling?
faqs.answer: No. Adam is an ordained minister providing pastoral coaching and discipleship — not a licensed therapist. If you need clinical mental health support, we'll help you find the right resource. Our focus is biblical, practical, and relational.

faqs.question: What if I can't afford coaching?
faqs.answer: Ministry comes first. If money is a barrier, reach out anyway. We'll work something out. No one gets turned away for financial reasons.

faqs.question: Is this only for Marines or military?
faqs.answer: Not at all. USMC stands for "Uniting, Serving, Mentoring, Counseling" — our ministry pillars. All men are welcome regardless of background.

faqs.question: How do I cancel Warriors Circle?
faqs.answer: Cancel anytime — no contracts, no hoops. One email or message and you're done. We want brothers, not hostages.

faqs.question: Do you offer group sessions or retreats?
faqs.answer: Yes — group coaching is part of the Warriors Circle. Retreat planning is coming in 2026-2027. Stay tuned via the Field Brief newsletter.

faqs.question: What does C5iSR actually sell?
faqs.answer: Not chatbots and not an AI course. A scoped agent-backed operating package: free consult, written scope, then roughly $3,000 over 3 months to diagnose, build, train, and stabilize 1–2 named workflows plus a knowledge/memory layer. Invoiced through C5iSR LLC. Not registered investment, legal, or tax advice.

faqs.question: Who is the C5iSR package for?
faqs.answer: Owner-operated businesses, roughly 5–40 people, who want AI as infrastructure rather than another chat tab. Fit is checked on a free discovery call before any invoice.

faqs.question: How does the engagement work?
faqs.answer: Free 15–30 minute discovery consult, then a recorded scope and written statement of work before any invoice. Then build and train 1–2 named workflows plus a knowledge/memory layer, with about 3 months of agent-backed stabilization support.

faqs.question: Do I have to buy a local AI box?
faqs.answer: No. Hardware is billed separately only if you choose local gear. Private or on-prem AI can sit inside the package when privacy is the differentiator. There is no public appliance catalog.

faqs.question: How do I start?
faqs.answer: Book a free consult at https://calendly.com/adamljohns or email c5isrllc97@gmail.com.
